name: hyaluronan binding protein 2

function.text: HABP2 encodes factor VII-activating protease [Cleaved into: Factor VII-activating protease 50 kDa N-terminal heavy chain; Factor VII-activating protease 50 kDa N-terminal heavy chain alternate form; Factor VII-activating protease 27 kDa C-terminal light chain; Factor VII-activating protease 27 kDa C-terminal light chain alternate form]. Annotated molecular activities include peptidase activity and serine-type endopeptidase activity. It participates in proteolysis and cell adhesion.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.
